=== health
usage: node scripts/health.mjs [--json | --legacy | --backlog]

Reports wiki integrity: open defects, unresolved navigation and the unscored notes. --json prints the full worklist, --legacy the historical score, --backlog only the ingest backlog. Choose one.
Read-only.
The vault is the one named by WIKI_MASTER_VAULT (default: ~/.wiki-master-vault).
=== doctor
usage: node scripts/doctor.mjs [command ...] [--json]

Reports, for each command of the plugin, the programs and packages it needs from this machine, the path and
version found, and how to fix what is missing. It starts each program once with its version flag, never the
Obsidian CLI, and it writes nothing and uses no vault.
Name commands to ask about them (vault, clip, clip-pdf, clip-docx, clip-pptx, clip-xlsx, clip-gh, clip-confluence): the exit status is 1 when a
required entry of one of them is missing. With no names it reports everything and exits 0.
--json prints one object: this copy and the installed version, every requirement, every command, and the exit code.
=== lint
usage: node scripts/lint.mjs [--json] [--full] [--near] [--tier=<convention|gapped|unverified|all>] [--page=<path>]
                             [--paths-file=<ledger>] [--updated-since=<YYYY-MM-DD>] [--ids] [--include-reviewed]

Content lint: warn-only flags for review (quotes, run-of-spaces, near matches), never scored.
  --json         machine-readable output
  --full         do not shorten quotes in the listing
  --near         add the word diff of each unverified quote against its raw clipping
  --tier=<name>  list one quote tier only
  --page=<path>  limit the report to pages whose path contains this text (the whole vault is still examined)
  --paths-file=<ledger>      examine only the pages a JSON array of vault-relative paths names
  --updated-since=<date>     examine only pages whose `updated` is on or after the date; with --paths-file, both must hold
  --ids          show the id of each finding, which lint-disposition.mjs takes
  --include-reviewed         list findings that have a recorded verdict too, with the verdict
When lint-dispositions.jsonl exists in the vault, findings with a recorded verdict are not listed and the summary counts them.
The vault is the one named by WIKI_MASTER_VAULT (default: ~/.wiki-master-vault).
=== stale
usage: node scripts/stale.mjs

Read-only freshness report: which wiki pages have not been reviewed recently. Never writes.
Takes no options.
The vault is the one named by WIKI_MASTER_VAULT (default: ~/.wiki-master-vault).
=== validate-authored
usage: node scripts/validate-authored.mjs --paths-file <ledger.json> [--json] [--terms-file <file>] [--terms-projects <list>]

Checks the frontmatter, placement and links of exactly the pages one authoring task wrote (the ledger: a JSON array of vault-relative paths). Prints one "path:line rule message" line per defect; exit 0 is clean, 1 means defects, 2 an unusable ledger or vault.
Read-only.
The vault is the one named by WIKI_MASTER_VAULT (default: ~/.wiki-master-vault).
=== search
usage: node scripts/search.mjs "<question>" [--json] [--limit N] [--project P] [--type T] [--status S] [--include-raw]
       node scripts/search.mjs --health | --setup

Searches the wiki with keyword, identity and semantic channels and prints ranked pages with citations. --health reports which channels are available; --setup prints how to enable the missing ones.
Read-only.
The vault is the one named by WIKI_MASTER_VAULT (default: ~/.wiki-master-vault).
=== index-embed
usage: node scripts/index-embed.mjs [--rebuild] [--status] [--concurrency=<n>]

Refreshes the semantic search index from the files that changed since its last run.
  --rebuild          discard the index and embed every page again
  --status           report the index state and exit without changing it
  --concurrency=<n>  embedding requests in flight (default 4)
The vault is the one named by WIKI_MASTER_VAULT (default: ~/.wiki-master-vault).

The vault is not healthy. It has one open integrity defect, three pages with no review date, and no semantic search at all. I only read and ran read-only helpers, and the vault's `git status` is still clean. I wrote one scratch file, `ledger.json`, to TEMP for the validator.

## Vault health
- **Open defects:** `health.mjs` reports 1 (target 0) across 9 content pages, 2 of which require evidence and 4 are stubs.
- **The defect:** `wiki/concepts/Beacon Protocol Draft.md:4` is flagged `missing-evidence`. It is a substantive derived page with no unambiguous evidence route to raw within three hops.
- **Navigation:** 0 unresolved links.
- **Backlog:** `wiki/authored/beacon/backlog/parallel-workers.md` has the status `open`, which the helper doesn't recognise. The generated roadmap would list it under "Unrecognized status".
- **Scope:** health checks structure only. It says nothing about whether the content is true or complete.

## Freshness
`stale.mjs` reports: fresh 0, aging 4, stale 0, rotten 3, missing review 3.
- The three pages with no review date are `Beacon Protocol Draft.md`, `north/Harbor.md` and `south/Harbor.md`, all under `wiki/concepts/`.
- Obsidian's `base:query` returned invalid JSON, so the report fell back to reading the filesystem. Obsidian wasn't used, and the result should still be valid.
- The helper doesn't name the 4 aging and 3 rotten pages in its output.

## Lint
- `lint.mjs` found no quote problems. It examined 0 quotes, found 0 gapped or unverified ones, and raised 0 style flags.
- That clean result mostly means there was little to check, not that the content was verified.

## Validation of the two authored pages
`validate-authored.mjs` exited 1 after checking both pages. It found 1 defect:
- `wiki/authored/beacon/backlog/parallel-workers.md:11` has `backlog-status: open`. The allowed values are `in-progress`, `planned`, `blocked`, `shipped` and `dropped`.
- `wiki/authored/beacon/architecture.md` is clean.
- The page's `status: maintained` and `reviewed: 2026-10-01` are not flagged.

## Why search has no semantic coverage
`search.mjs --health` reports the tier as lexical, meaning keyword and identity matching only. Two things cause it:
1. **The embedding service is unreachable.** `OLLAMA_HOST` is set in this environment to `http://127.0.0.1:1`, which is a dead port. The default would be `localhost:11434`. Search reports `reachable=false` and `model-pulled=false` for `nomic-embed-text`. I don't know whether `nomic-embed-text` is installed, because the helper couldn't reach a server to ask.
2. **The semantic index is empty.** `index-embed.mjs --status` shows 0 files and 0 chunks, with 8 files changed since the last refresh. Even with Ollama running, semantic ranking would return nothing until the index is built.

## What search covers today
- **Covered:** keyword and identity matches only. Semantic ranking can't be fused in, so results depend on literal wording, which hurts paraphrased or concept-level queries.
- **Not covered:** semantic matches across all 8 changed files and all 9 content pages.

The helper's own fix is `ollama serve`, but the environment variable would still point at the dead port. Fixing it would also mean building the index, which I did not do because you asked for a read-only diagnostic.
